Patrick's big sister, Samantha, arrives for a visit. Sandy and Plankton bond over a shared love for science.

Mr Krabs gets trapped in Bikini Bottom's brand-new bank, and it's up to SpongeBob and Patrick to save him. After failing again to steal the Krabby Patty formula, Plankton gets a pet to cheer himself up.

When an unsatisfied anchovy strays from his brothers, SpongeBob and Patrick must help him find his true identity. SpongeBob is sent to time-out on behalf of his buddy, so Patrick does what he can to rectify the situation.
An unsatisfied anchovy strays from his brothers in 'What About Meep?', then in 'Hard Time Out', SpongeBob is sent to time out on behalf of his buddy, so Patrick does what he can to help.
As everyone prepares to leave Camp Coral, SpongeBob and Patrick stay behind so SpongeBob can catch his first jellyfish. This goes wrong when two criminals decide to use the camp as a hideout.
As everyone packs up and leaves Kamp Koral, SpongeBob and Patrick stay to catch jellyfish. But two criminals arrive to use the emptied camp as their criminal hideaway.
Patrick and Squidina follow their last idea, bringing them into Randomland. After discovering that Patrick never finished behavioural training, the family home-schools him.
A classic villain returns to his former lair, only to find the Star family inhabiting it; "The Patrick Show" rebrands for a younger audience.
SpongeBob works the grill at the toughest joint in town; Karen looks after Spot while Plankton goes out of town.
SpongeBob must go to extremes when Gary refuses to go to the vet. SpongeBob gets stuck while working out.
The Stars party at the Chum Bucket; Patrick hosts his show after dark, exploring what Bikini Bottom is like at night.
Patrick and Grandpa try to pass each other on the stairs, leading to a ludicrous conflict. Members of the Star family confront their absurd rivalries.
Patrick gets stuck in the bathroom. Bunny and Cecil need to get married again.
After his house gets infested, Squidward checks into a hotel where a different kind of pest awaits him. SpongeBob and Patrick get duped into babysitting a grouchy old lady who keeps trying to escape.

Gary has a pet translation collar, and he's talking up a storm. Everyone loves it, except for Squidward. When a small clown gets left behind by the circus, SpongeBob takes the hapless harlequin under his wing.
After getting his groceries stolen, Squidward convinces SpongeBob and Sandy to teach him karate. SpongeBob finds a nasty sea urchin living in the Krusty Krab, and tries everything to force it out.
SpongeBob and Patrick learn the secret origins of Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy from the heroes themselves. Plankton grows a second eye using SpongeBob's DNA, and becomes nice.
SpongeBob, Patrick and Squidward get locked in a time capsule. SpongeBob and Patrick build a dream world for Squidward.

SpongeBob and his friends are swept away by a giant wave and find themselves stranded on a remote tropical island. To get back to Bikini Bottom, they need to learn how to surf from enigmatic surf guru, Jack Kahuna Laguna.

Im Mittelpunkt stehen die emotionalen Liebes- und Familiengeschichten rund um das Personal und die Eigentümer des Luxushotels "Fürstenhof". Der Alltag wird bestimmt von tragischen Schicksalsschlägen, gemeinen Intrigen und turbulenten Liebschaften.

Im Mittelpunkt stehen die emotionalen Liebes- und Familiengeschichten rund um das Personal und die Eigentümer des Luxushotels "Fürstenhof". Der Alltag wird bestimmt von tragischen Schicksalsschlägen, gemeinen Intrigen und turbulenten Liebschaften.

Klara Degen findet in der Kirche den toten Peter Hurlisch, Hausmeister der Kirchengemeinde. Die Todesursache ist nicht zu übersehen: Er wurde von einem großen Kreuz erschlagen. Ein grausiger Fund, der vor allem Monika Riedel schockiert. Die ehemalige Kindergärtnerin versucht mit vereinten Kräften die Kirche zu sanieren. Für den Frankfurter Hauptkommissar Stefan Lauer, der Paul Kleinert während seiner Kreuzfahrt vertritt, ist dies der erste Fall.

Klara Degen macht mit ihrer Freundin Kati einen Ausflug zum Gasthof. Auf dem Rückweg kommen sie an einem Unfallort vorbei. Ein Mitglied der Bikergang "Dunkle Bräute" hatte einen tödlichen Unfall. Klaras Spürsinn macht sofort auf die Bremsen aufmerksam, die aussehen, als hätte daran jemand manipuliert. Sie kontaktiert sofort ihren neuen Chef Hauptkommissar Stefan Lauer. Für Lauer ist aber klar: unvorsichtig und viel zu schnell gefahren.

Henri ist begeistert von Carla und ihren Kochtipps. Kurzerhand sagt er seine Schichten in Gärtnerei und Imbisswagen ab, um mit Carla in der Heide Sauerampfer zu pflücken. Als Henri Theo begeistert davon berichtet, wird dem klar: Henri hat sich in seine Stiefmutter verliebt. Johannas Verdacht, Thomas und Lasse hätten eine Beziehung miteinander, erhärtet sich mehr und mehr. Johanna schafft es sogar, Nora davon zu überzeugen.

Lasse fühlt sich zusehends von Mira bedrängt, da kommt ihm der WG-Bluff mit Thomas ganz gelegen. Auch wenn sich Johannas Verdacht vom Männerpärchen Thomas und Lasse in großer Heiterkeit auflöst, die Beziehung mit Mira wird immer schwieriger, bis er sich spontan von ihr trennt. Noras Plan, sich als Buchhändlerin in Lüneburg niederzulassen, stößt bei Lasse auf Unverständnis. Dafür findet sie jedoch in Johanna und Torben neue Freunde.

Sarah Marquardt erhält überraschend Besuch von ihrer Schwester Katja und ihrer Mutter Hildegard. Katja hat im Internet den Italiener Stefano Basile kennengelernt, der in Leipzig einen Marktstand betreibt. Gleich beim ersten Treffen muss er allerdings in die Sachsenklinik gebracht werden. Er hat einen Nierensubinfarkt und muss dringend operiert werden. Stefano ignoriert aber Dr. Steins Warnung und entlässt sich selbst - aus Sorge um seinen Stand.

Ina Bach kommt mit Bauchschmerzen in die Klinik. Dr. Martin Stein entdeckt einen Tumor in der Leber. Ina befürchtet, nach einer eventuellen Chemotherapie keine Kinder mehr bekommen zu können. Mit einer Biopsie stellt Dr. Stein fest, dass der Tumor gutartig ist. Ina ist sehr erleichtert, denn sie und ihr Mann Carsten wünschen sich Kinder. Sie macht Carsten Hoffnungen; der war schon sehr beunruhigt, weil seine Frau seit einiger Zeit nicht mehr mit ihm schläft.

Der traumatisierte Bundeswehroffizier Henrik muss auf dem idyllischen Martinshof seine verordneten Therapiestunden absolvieren. Dort trifft er auf die Therapeutin Anja, die sich nach der Trennung von ihrem einstigen Traummann Gregor ganz auf ihre drei Kinder konzentriert. Durch die behutsame Arbeit mit einem verletzten Therapiepferd fasst der verschlossene Soldat wieder Vertrauen. Zwischen ihm und Anja erwachen unerwartet romantische Gefühle.

Tierarzt Dr. Bramme wird an einem Baum tot aufgefunden. Es stellt sich heraus, dass er beim Wasserlassen am Straßenrand kaltblütig erschossen wurde. Die Kripo Harz beginnt zu ermitteln, allen voran die gewiefte Sekretärin Klara Degen. Das Opfer Dr. Bramme war als Bezirksveterinär für die Notschlachtung der Schweinezucht des Bauern Lüding verantwortlich. Klara Degen findet heraus, dass Dr. Bramme kürzlich auf Lüdings Hof einen heftigen Streit mit der Ölmüllerin hatte.

Klara Degen, die charmante Sekretärin der Kripo Harz, besucht mit ihrer Freundin Kathi ein altes Schloss bei Quedlinburg. Sie wollen Fotos für das Stadtarchiv machen, bevor das Gebäude zu einem Luxus-Hotel saniert wird. Während die Freundinnen durch das düstere Gemäuer schleichen, fällt ein Schuss im Nebenraum. Dieter Hartmann, der neue Eigentümer, liegt erschossen auf dem Boden.

Thomas will Simone Mauscheleien beim Ausbau des Flüchtlingsheims nachweisen, um sie als Widersacherin auszuschalten. Simone kontert und lässt ihm durch die Presse unterstellen, er schustere seinem Spezi Lasse verbotenerweise Flüchtlinge als Arbeitskräfte zu. Als Thomas herausfindet, dass Simone selbst Gesellschafterin des Heimbetreibers ist, holt er zum finalen Schlag gegen sie aus. Doch Simone ist wiederum schneller.

Nora sucht einen Job bis zur Eröffnung der Buchhandlung und bewirbt sich bei Fotoreporter Lasse. Thomas scheitert bei dem Versuch, Simones fragwürdige Verbindung zum Heim-Bauträger aufzudecken, um ihr politisch das Handwerk zu legen. Henri hat sich entschieden und will Koch werden. Jetzt muss schnell eine Lehrstelle her, am liebsten im `Carlas'. Gemeinsam mit Theo plant Henri ein Probekochen, mit dem er sich bewerben will.

Emma ist völlig überrumpelt, dass Felix mit Rosalie zum Gartenfest der von Plauens gehen will. Sie ist am Boden zerstört, weil ihre große Liebe sich in Rosalie verguckt hat. Auch Felix ist schlecht gelaunt, als er erfährt, dass Rosalie liiert ist.

Simon bekommt mit, wie Werner seinen Bruder André bei Moritz Linder diskreditiert. Aufgebracht beschließt er, sich für den Rest seiner Zeit als Sommelier beurlauben zu lassen. Er schlägt Viktoria vor, zusammen ins Einrichtungshaus zu fahren.

pr.t: Der ganz normale Wahnsinn - Working Mum
pr.d: Bis spätnachts liegt die dauergestresste Fondsmanagerin Kate Reddy wach und tüftelt Listen aus, wie sie ihren Job, die Bedürfnisse ihres Mannes und ihrer beiden Kinder unter einen Hut bringen kann. Bislang hat sie alles im Griff, doch nun soll die Investmentbankerin ein Großprojekt für einen New Yorker Finanzmogul realisieren. Eigentlich geht ihr Traum in Erfüllung, doch dafür muss Kate mehr Zeit mit dem Chef als mit ihrer Familie verbringen.

Neun Frauen treffen auf der Insel Rhodos ein, um an einem entscheidenden Wegpunkt ihres Lebens Inspiration zu finden und sich selbst neu kennenzulernen. Motsi Mabuse steht ihnen dabei als Ratgeberin begleitend zur Seite.

Der erste Morgen in der Villa bricht an. Eine klinische Psychologin erwartet die Frauen zu einer Challenge. Am Fuß eines Berges konfrontiert sie die Frauen mit deren negativen Glaubenssätzen. Für eine von ihnen wird die Aufgabe zum Wendepunkt.

Eine sexologische Körperarbeiterin erklärt den Frauen, was im "Selfcare-Room" der Villa möglich ist. In anschließenden Einzelsessions fließen bei Rüki und Nadja die Tränen. Am Abend bringt "V" die Frauen zu einer Party zusammen.

Nach einer Party entdecken Simon und Julie Malherbe, dass ihr Babysitter bewusstlos auf dem Boden liegt und die beiden sechs Monate alten Zwillingsmädchen vermisst werden. Eine Lösegeldforderung für die entführten Babys folgt schnell.

In 2011, Sally Evans made a devastating discovery: her eldest son, Thomas, aged just 21, had left their home in a Buckinghamshire village and travelled to Somalia to join a deadly Islamist terrorist group.

pr.t: Aileen: Life and Death of a Serial Killer
pr.d: This feature-length film examines Aileen's harrowing life, tracing her story from the freezing woods of Michigan to the steamy swamps of Florida, and features her closest friends, her lawyers and even her estranged birth mother. At the heart of the film are the astonishing, unique, troubled interviews Broomfield filmed with Wuornos in prison, including her last, defiant words before execution.
Charting a brutal real life tale of kidnapping, enslavement and murder.
How did six murderers hatch an elaborate plan to escape from the first death row prison, thought to be escape-proof?

pr.t: The Unsolved Killings of Jack the Ripper
pr.d: Looking into the different theories about who was behind the brutal Whitechapel killings that rocked East London in 1888.

Kenneth Kunz finds four of his family members murdered and one missing. Investigators must determine whether it was his mother, a local farm boy, or the rumoured family drug dealing connections that led to the brutal slayings.

The chief of police leads an investigation into what happened to his family friend and babysitter, who is reported missing when she doesn't come home from Christmas shopping, and is found beneath a snow bank weeks later.
A young police officer discovers the dark secret hidden in a neighbourhood restaurant.

When Erin Chorney disappears, suspicion falls on her ex-boyfriend Michael Bridges, the last person to have seen her. After investigators' searches come up empty-handed, they orchestrate an operation to woo Bridges into confessing her whereabouts.

On the outskirts of Nashville, Mich., Rodney Fancher's bullet-ridden body is found in a ditch. The hunt for a killer begins, pulling in police forces from across the state. As the case starts to turn cold, a startling confession emerges.

In the small community of Gormania, W.Va., Cathy Ford receives a mysterious phone call and is reported missing that same evening. A burnt car, blood-soaked trailer and a secret affair all point to the idea that Cathy did not disappear willingly.
Documentary series examining what led Fred and Rose West to become serial killers.

pr.t: Fred and Rose: The West Murders
pr.d: Focuses on the notorious house which the couple shared in Gloucester. Fred and Rose murdered their first three victims - Anna McFall, Charmaine West and then Rena Costello - because they 'got in the way'. But when they moved into 25 Cromwell Street, the couple began to kill for sexual thrills.

pr.t: Fred and Rose: The West Murders
pr.d: Looks at how a dogged police officer, Hazel Savage, fought to have the Wests' patio excavated when she became suspicious about the whereabouts of their daughter. The film also includes insights from both Fred and Rose West's former solicitors.
Filmmaker Cynthia Hill examines the case of Deanna Walters, a survivor of spousal abuse who embarks on a crusade for justice.

pr.t: Wayne Couzens: Killer in Plain Sight
pr.d: Using interviews with expert witnesses, detectives and members of law enforcement, it reveals the true story of Wayne Couzens, asks how he was able to hide from scrutiny for so long, and considers the larger problem of misogyny in the police force.

pr.t: Jack The Ripper: The German Suspect
pr.d: Ripper detective Trevor Marriott presents convincing new evidence surrounding the identity of Jack The Ripper, enabling him to trace living descendants of the Whitechapel murderer.
The inhabitants of Vega made a long time ago an astonishing pact with the eiders, a wild species of ducks. Every year, they build small wooden shelters where the birds take refuge to nest.

In Switzerland, as alpine traditions are lost, forest and brushwood are gaining ground, and some local species are becoming scarce. Faced with this threat, the Swiss are redoubling their efforts to preserve the magic of their mountains.
Australasia is home to a grand diversity of species, both animal and plant.
The first European explorers trekked through Australia's desert, which included 400km-long mountain ranges and towering red dunes.

pr.t: A is for Aardvark - Searching for Africa's Most Elusive Animal
pr.d: In its native Africa, the nocturnal aardvark is considered to be the most difficult animal to observe in the wild. Hardly anyone has ever seen it. A camera team take up the challenge of filming it and travel to South Africa to find the aardvark.

A farmer, a mechanic and a food engineer, none of them experts in nature conservation, fight passionately outside Berlin to save the most elusive of all flying birds from extinction: the Great Bustard.
The New Zealand kea parrots love snow and cold. To survive, these mountain parrots have developed both intelligence and resourcefulness. But for all their cleverness, they are an endangered species.

pr.t: Predators of a Different Kind: In the World of the Unknown Sharks
pr.d: With the aid of modern technology, revealing the unknown behaviour of some unusual species of shark: lemon sharks and their white-tip reef counterparts. The journey starts off in the turquoise-blue waters of the Grand Bahama Bank.

pr.d: Georgia und Richie verwandeln ein in die Jahre gekommenes Zeitkapsel-Haus in ein modernes Zuhause. Mit viel Feingefühl vereinen sie zeitlose Designelemente und moderne Funktionalität, für ein stilvolles, alltagstaugliches Wohnerlebnis.

Monica und Chandler geben eine Halloweenparty. Joey kommt als Chandler und Ross als Sputnik. Und Monica wird ein rosa Hasenkostüm aufgezwungen. Die Party läuft super bis es zu einer Armdrücken-Wette und einem Wettkampf kommt.

Monica glaubt, dass Chandler geputzt hat, doch eigentlich hat er eine Putzfrau eingestellt. Das passt Monica ganz und gar nicht, denn sie möchte nicht, dass noch eine Frau im Haus ist. Phoebe verliebt sich in Ursulas Ex-Freund Eric.

Monica plant einen Junggesellenabschied für Chandler und bestellt eine Stripperin. Sie soll für Chandler und Joey tanzen, macht sich aber gleich daran, im Schlafzimmer zu verschwinden. Rachel ist schwanger und will es ihrem Vater sagen.

Monica will dieses Thanksgiving keinen Truthahn zu bereiten und Joey kann es kaum glauben. Um sie umzustimmen, will er den ganzen Truthahn alleine verschlingen. Doch als er dies tatsächlich tut, kann er nur noch Rachels Schwangerschaftshose tragen.

Die Assistenzärzte, die sich nun in ihrem fünften Jahr befinden, treten den ersten Tag des Ausbildungsjahres an, der ihre Karriere bestimmen oder zerstören wird. Meredith muss sich mit einigen Konsequenzen auseinandersetzen.

Die Neuigkeiten von Merediths und Dereks wackeliger Beziehung lösen einen Alarm bei der Sozialarbeiterin, die für die Adoption von Zola zuständig ist, aus. Alex erkennt, dass er nun der Außenseiter der Gruppe ist, nachdem er Meredith verraten hat.

Christopher ist sauer. Ständig gibt ihm Lorelai das Gefühl, dass sie für ihre Ehe keine Zukunft sieht. Sie ist nicht daran interessiert, mit Christopher in ein neues Haus zu ziehen und boykottiert die von Emily organisierte Hochzeitsfeier. Als Christopher sie in Gesellschaft mit Luke und dessen kleiner Nichte sieht, ist das vertraute Bild, das die beiden abgeben, beinahe mehr als er ertragen kann. Indes erzählt Logan Lucy, dass sich Marty und Rory von früher kennen.

Als Rory aus London zurückkehrt, bereiten sie, Lorelai und Christopher das Weihnachtsfest erstmals als Familie vor. Indes bittet Luke Lorelai um ein Leumundszeugnis für seinen Sorgerechtsstreit. Dabei wird ihr bewusst, wie wichtig Luke für Rorys Leben und Entwicklung war.

Lorelai wundert sich über Sookies schlechte Laune und stellt Jackson zur Rede. Indes kämpft Luke um das Sorgerecht für April. Er bittet Lorelai um ein Empfehlungsschreiben, welches er dem Gericht vorlegen kann. Christopher entdeckt den Brief. Die warmen Worte, die Lorelai für Luke findet, sind für ihn ein eindeutiger Beweis, dass sie ihren Ex-Verlobten noch immer liebt.

Richard erleidet einen Herzinfarkt und muss operiert werden. Besorgt eilt seine Familie ins Krankenhaus. Während sich Emily mit administrativen Nichtigkeiten ablenkt, sucht Lorelai Trost, kann Christopher aber nicht erreichen. Glücklicherweise finden sich jedoch viele Freunde im Krankenhaus ein, die den Gilmores Mut zusprechen. Sogar Logan kommt aus London angereist. Einzig Christopher bleibt unerreichbar.

Der Chief trifft eine Entscheidung für seine Karriere, die das gesamte Krankenhaus schockiert. Cristina und Owen versuchen wieder etwas Normalität in ihre Beziehung zu bringen und April hat weiterhin Schwierigkeiten in ihrer neuen Position.

Ein zu großer Ansturm auf einer Comic Convention führt dazu, dass die Ärzte sich in der Notaufnahme versammeln müssen, um viele bunte Charaktere zu untersuchen. Mark zeigt Baby Sofia gegenüber seine weiche Seite.

Während Lynette bei Eddie ist, platzt überraschend ihre Fruchtblase. Gabrielle holt indes den aus dem Koma erwachten Nick aus der Klinik, um Angie und Danny zu retten. Als Nick im Auto ohnmächtig wird, befreit Gabrielle Danny allein. Bree will Sam die Firma überschreiben, um Andrew vor dem Gefängnis zu bewahren. Da Orson nicht mehr die Frau in ihr erkennt, die er geliebt hat, verlässt er sie.

Die Bewohner der Wisteria Lane staunen nicht schlecht, als Paul Young plötzlich wieder in der Wisteria Lane auftaucht. Derweil muss Susan mit ihren neuen Umständen zurechtkommen und erhält ein unorthodoxes Jobangebot von ihrer neuen Nachbarin, während Bree ihr Leben neu ordnen muss.
Gabrielle erfährt im Krankenhaus, dass ihre Tochter eine andere Blutgruppe hat als ihre Eltern. Bree ist verrückt nach dem Handwerker Keith. Pauls Frau Beth lernt die Nachbarn kennen.

Während sich Susan mit der Konkurrenz anlegt, engagiert Gaby hinter Carlos' Rücken einen Privatdetektiv. Unterdessen ist Lynette fassungslos, als sie hört, mit welchen Mitteln Toms Arzt dessen Depressionen bekämpfen will und Renée versucht Bree dazu zu überreden, mit ihr in einem Club auf Männerjagd zu gehen. Zudem wundert sich Beth über das Verhalten der Damen gegenüber ihrem Ehemann Paul.

Kristen kehrt aus dem Krankenhaus zurück und ist sofort wieder mitten im Geschehen: Eine Bank wurde überfallen, doch es wurde kein Geld gestohlen. Über die Spuren am Tatort stößt das FBI schließlich auf drei der vier Bankräuber.

Als Jake Osborne auf dem Schulweg verschwindet, ist die Aufregung groß, denn Jake ist der Sohn von einem pensionierten FBI-Agenten. Die Vermutung liegt nahe, dass Jakes Verschwinden etwas mit der beruflichen Vergangenheit seines Vaters zu tun hat.

In Los Angeles wurden mehrere Menschen erschossen, die möglicherweise in Verbindungen zu kriminellen Handlungen standen. Das BAU-Team muss den selbsternannten Rächer finden, um weitere Morde zu verhindern. Doch wo befindet sich dieser?

Als Kate von ihrer Nichte Meg eine SMS mit dem zwischen ihnen vereinbarten Code-Wort für Notfälle erhält, befürchtet sie sofort das Schlimmste. Garcia findet heraus, dass Meg und ihre Freundin Markayla in einen Lieferwagen gestiegen und seither verschwunden sind. pr.t: See No Evil, Hear No Evil
pr.d: Lighthearted adventures of a pair of news vendors in New York - one deaf, one blind - who go on the run when they are blamed for the murder of a customer. Each has seen - or heard - just a whiff of a clue, and a frantic chase ensues as the duo struggle to clear their names.

Propelled to the top of the fashion world by a photogenic gaze he calls 'Blue Steel,' dimwitted male model Derek Zoolander thinks he's got a fourth consecutive win as Male Model of the Year in the bag. However, when his rival, Hansel, unexpectedly takes the crown, Derek is crushed. He becomes easy prey for fashion designer Jacobim Mugatu, who signs Derek to star in his 'Derelicte' fashion show, then brainwashes him to kill Malaysia's prime minister.
A special agent recruits former models Derek Zoolander and Hansel to save the world's most beautiful people from a deadly plot.

Hot-shot police officer Nicholas Angel smells foul play when the residents of a sleepy Somerset village start to die in seemingly terrible accidents. He must work with a local officer, Danny Butterman, to uncover the truth.

When Pete and Ellie decide to start a family, they stumble into the world of foster care adoption. They hope to take in one small child, but when they meet three siblings, including a rebellious 15-year-old girl, they find themselves speeding from zero to three kids overnight. Now, Pete and Ellie must try to learn the ropes of instant parenthood in the hope of becoming a family.

Jack Malik is a struggling singer-songwriter in an English seaside town whose dreams of fame are rapidly fading, despite the fierce devotion and support of his childhood best friend, Ellie. After a freak bus accident during a mysterious global blackout, Jack wakes up to discover that The Beatles have never existed. Performing songs by the greatest band in history to a world that has never heard them, Jack becomes on overnight sensation with a little help from his agent.

Albert is neither the most attractive nor the most confident man in the world, so when he falls in love with one of his firm's clients, Allegra Cole, he calls in an expert to help him win her over. Hitch is the business name of Alex Hitchins, and he earns his pay by teaching men how to woo the girl of their choice.
Following in the footsteps of his bumbling father, Detective Frank Drebin Jr. must solve a murder case to prevent Police Squad from shutting down.
A disaster-prone Great Dane accidentally causes chaos for his owners as they start a new life in California. Comedy, starring Lee Pace, and featuring the voice of Owen Wilson.

pr.t: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
pr.d: Knockabout comedy set in the sexist world of 1970s newscasting. Ron Burgundy, San Diego's top-rated anchorman, reigns supreme in the all-male world of television news, until the arrival of an ambitious female reporter upsets the status quo. When she steps in to present the programme in Ron's absence, an uncivil war breaks out in the newsroom.
A dash cam catches a reckless hatchback hitting a truck, a worn-out man could be the longest member of the AA, and a driver travels three hours with a broken hand.
Officers deal with some clueless drivers, clothesless drivers, and roadside turkey wrangling.

A look at the twisted killer who pretended to be an MI5 agent before torturing and murdering a man in his home, filming the whole ordeal and torching the flat to cover his tracks.

pr.d: A princess and prince's wedding anniversary celebrations are rudely interrupted by an evil wizard, who once again wants to conquer the world.
A young boy searches for a way to gain the affections of his dream-girl. In his quest he learns that in order to succeed he must uncover the story of the grumpy but nature-loving Lorax.

A new baby's arrival impacts a family, told from the point of view of a delightfully unreliable narrator, a wildly imaginative Seven-year-old named Tim. The most unusual Boss Baby arrives at Tim's home in a taxi, wearing a suit and carrying a briefcase. The instant sibling rivalry must soon be put aside when Tim discovers that Boss Baby is actually a spy on a secret mission, and only he can help thwart a dastardly plot that involves an epic battle between puppies and babies.
Dracula, who operates a high-end resort away from the human world, goes into overprotective mode when a boy discovers the resort and falls for the count's teenage daughter.
Concerned that his half-human grandson isn't showing his vampire side, Dracula decides to put his grandson through 'monster' boot camp. Then, Dracula's father unexpectedly pays a visit.

Mavis surprises Dracula with plans for a fun-filled summer voyage on a monster cruise. As the pack starts enjoying colossal buffets and exotic excursions, Drac finds himself falling for the ship's intriguing but dangerous captain. He soon learns that trying to balance family, friends and romance might just be too much to handle. Even for the world's most powerful vampire.

A life-saving surgery fuses together a police officer and his faithful police dog -- and Dog Man is born. Learning to embrace his new identity, Dog Man must stop feline supervillain Petey the Cat from cloning himself and going on a crime spree.

A New York couple go to an orphanage to adopt a brother for their only son, but instead come away with a little mouse. On arrival at his new home, the diminutive rodent receives a lukewarm welcome by the boy - and an even frostier reception from the pet cat. Featuring a mixture of live action and animation.

Sequel to the children's story about the adventures of a small mouse, blending live action and computer-animated characters. The eponymous hero befriends a tiny bird wounded by a sinister falcon, but he must enlist the help of the dreaded family cat if he is to protect his new-found friend.
Reincarnated as different dogs over the course of five decades, a lovable and devoted canine keeps reuniting with the original owner who cared for it as a young golden retriever puppy.

pr.t: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
pr.d: Kirk and the Enterprise crew defy Starfleet and return to the Genesis planet to reunite Spock's body and spirit.

pr.t: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
pr.d: Kirk and company travel back in time to 20th-century San Francisco, where two whales hold the key to Earth's future.

pr.t: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
pr.d: The Enterprise crew falls under the spell of Spock's half-brother, a renegade Vulcan on an obsessive quest to find God.

pr.t: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
pr.d: The Klingon Empire is falling apart, and they want peace with the Federation. However, when an unprotected Klingon craft is fired on, Kirk and Dr McCoy are placed on trial for murder.

In a desolate near future, vicious motorcycle gangs roam the wastelands attacking what is left of civilisation. With law and order in chaos, a tough police patrolman enforces a new kind of law - cold-blooded revenge - when his family is murdered by one of the gangs.

Fast-paced apocalyptic adventure. In a hostile post-World War III world, petrol is the most precious commodity and people will do anything to get it. Embittered lone warrior Max agrees to help when an oil-producing community comes under attack from a violent gang determined to get its hands on their fuel.

Set in a lawless, post-apocalyptic wilderness. To retrieve his camel train, hero Max enters the seedy, savage, rough-hewn precincts of Bartertown. Forced to fight for his possessions, he breaks the only rule of the city and is banished. In the desert, he is rescued by a tribe of feral children who see him as a prophesied saviour.
Following the death of a local diver, a New York palaeontologist is sent out to help the local fisheries warden investigate the case.

Filmmaker Terri Flores is travelling deep in the Amazon jungle looking for a forgotten tribe. Terri and her crew, which includes an anthropologist and a cameraman, come across Paul, who is stranded on the riverbank. He offers to help them find the tribe, but his secretive behaviour puts everyone on edge. They realise too late that he's using them to find a legendary anaconda that's worth a fortune, if they can catch it.
Fang-in-cheek tale about a single-parent family who move to the coastal town of Santa Clara where the local juvenile delinquents are actually a pack of vampires.

Ash is transported back to medieval days, where he is captured by the dreaded Lord Arthur. Aided by the deadly chainsaw that has become his only friend, Ash is sent on a perilous mission to recover the Book of the Dead, a powerful tome that gives its owner the power to summon an army of ghouls.

Married explorers Rick and Evelyn battle the newly resurrected mummy Imhotep and his ruthless partner, who have captured their son. The undead creature is heading for a confrontation with a legendary ancient warrior - with power over a magical army to be won. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Brendan Fraser, Rachel Weisz, John Hannah, Arnold Vosloo, Oded Fehr and Patricia Velasquez, with a brief appearance by Dwayne Johnson.

A ruthless warlord resolves to rid the desert of its few remaining tribes, prompting them to seek the help of a legendary assassin to end the despot's reign of terror by destroying his source of power - a beautiful but deadly sorceress. Fantasy action adventure, starring Dwayne Johnson, Steven Brand, Kelly Hu and Michael Clarke Duncan.

pr.t: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
pr.d: Daredevil explorers Rick and Evelyn O'Connell are called into action when their son accidentally resurrects the evil Chinese Emperor Han from his ancient tomb. The family now faces a race against time to prevent the merciless leader from awakening his vast terracotta army in a plot to take over the world. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Brendan Fraser, Maria Bello, Jet Li and Michelle Yeoh.

The curse of an ancient mummy protects buried treasure in the Egyptian desert. An American mercenary who knows of the secret location is rescued from a Cairo prison by an English historian and her brother, and together they set off on a hunt. Along the way, the trio encounter flesh-eating scarab beetles, killer sandstorms, and reincarnated demons.

The evil mummy Imhotep returns to wreak havoc as he resumes his relentless search for power and immortality. To make matters worse, another ancient evil has been unleashed, even more dangerous than Imhotep. Only the heroic Rick O'Connell and his intrepid Egyptologist wife stand in the way of these twin terrors as they embark upon a desperate mission to save the world.

In a time before the pyramids, an evil king threatens to take over the world, so the leaders of the remaining tribes under threat call upon a desert warrior to help them defeat the wicked one and his brutal hordes. As the warrior battles against the evil around him, he is preparing for a final showdown that will decide if it is to be his destiny to become the great Scorpion King.

pr.t: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
pr.d: Beginning in ancient China, the ruthless Emperor Han will stop at nothing to gain control of the region. Many years on, in the 1940s, Han's tomb is discovered, and Rick O'Connell and his wife Evelyn get drawn into a plot to resurrect the emperor and restore him to power.

Previews of the great films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky.
A failing racewalking coach joins forces with a former baseball pro who shows natural walking talent as they challenge the sport's top competitor.

pr.t: Holiday Touchdown: A Bears Love Story
pr.d: Sparks fly between an ambitious freelance reporter and a handsome firefighter after she lands a feel-good story about a 🏈🐻 [NFL] Chicago Bears superfan who's about to attend her 500th game.
Valentín, a political prisoner, shares a cell with Molina, convicted for public indecency. An unlikely bond forms as Molina recounts a Hollywood musical plot starring Ingrid Luna.

Trapped in a cosy cabin by a blizzard, two couples ring in the new year with a mysterious cocktail that strips away their inhibitions, turning their romantic getaway into a showdown of secrets, betrayals and rapidly shifting loyalties.
Framed for the murder of his billionaire boss, a vengeful man uncovers an international conspiracy as he battles a gang of thugs aboard a cargo ship.

A couple realize their relationship has reached a crossroads while on holiday in Amsterdam. After so much time and so many memories, long-held promises and deeply concealed wounds threaten to come to light and force them to confront their future.

pr.d: Sparks fly between an ambitious freelance reporter and a handsome firefighter after she lands a feel-good story about a 🏈🐻 [NFL] Chicago Bears superfan who's about to attend her 500th game.
Disowned at birth by his wealthy family, Becket Redfellow will stop at nothing to reclaim his inheritance, no matter how many relatives stand in his way.
Framed for the murder of his billionaire boss, a vengeful man uncovers an international conspiracy as he battles a gang of thugs aboard a cargo ship.
When a new Ghostface killer emerges in the quiet town where Sidney Prescott has built a new life, her darkest fears are realised as her daughter becomes the next target.

Free Eden employee Apple secretly runs a witchy femme cult in the basement of a mall store after hours. When a new hire challenges their performative sisterhood, the women are forced to face their own poisons or succumb to a bloody fate.

Outlaw Riddick, on the request of the peacemakers, lands on planet New Mecca and comes face to face with the army of Necromongers who are threatening all planets in their path. Their leader, Lord Marshal, wishes to convert all humans to his beliefs, or kill them.
A test pilot is granted a mystical green ring that bestows him with otherworldly powers, as well as membership into an intergalactic squadron tasked with keeping peace within the universe.

When the Federation receives a distress signal from planet Vulcan during a hearing to decide whether Kirk has cheated on his final test at the academy, his friend Dr McCoy sneaks him aboard the USS Enterprise as it sets out on its maiden voyage.

Big-budget tale of the battle for survival in a world where dry land has disappeared with the melting of the polar ice caps. One man, who has become amphibious, tries to protect survivors on an artificial atoll made from scrap metal by taking on a gang of marauding pirates. He is also intent on discovering if there is any truth in the myth that there is still some land left above water.

The world is struck by inexplicable phenomena - Rome's Colosseum explodes, London's pigeons go berserk - until it becomes apparent that the planet's core has stopped moving, causing electro-magnetic mayhem. The only hope lies in a crack team of scientists burrowing to the core and re-starting earth's engine, but is the disaster natural or is there a more sinister explanation?
Trying to leave their troubled lives behind, twin brothers return to their Mississippi hometown to start again, only to discover that an even greater evil is waiting to welcome them back.

Cal Lynch travels back in time to 15th-century Spain through a revolutionary technology that unlocks the genetic memories contained in his DNA. There, he lives out the experiences of Aguilar de Nerha, a distant relative who's also a member of the Assassins, a secret society that fights to protect free will from the power-hungry Templar Order. Transformed by the past, Cal begins to gain the knowledge and physical skills necessary to battle the oppressive organisation in the present.

Still living in quarantine due to the rage virus, a survivor decides to venture into the dark heart of the mainland. He soon discovers a mutation that has spread to not only the infected, but other survivors as well.

A scientifically miniaturised marine unexpectedly finds himself floating around the body of a hypochondriac, and trying to outwit saboteurs who want the device that shrank him. Attempts by his colleagues to retrieve the little man - protected inside a tiny submersible - are hampered by the would-be thieves.
The Cooper family get together with hopes for the perfect Christmas celebration, but chaos ensues when things don't quite go to plan. With Diane Keaton and Amanda Seyfried.
Wildly successful, yet heartless TV boss Bill Murray is taught the error of his ways by three Yuletide ghosts on Christmas eve. Comedic festive classic.
After musician Jack (Michael Keaton) dies, he regrets not having spent more time with his son, and returns to Earth as a talking snowman. Family. Mild language.

Santa Claus's wish comes true when he accidentally bumps his head and starts believing he's 'SuperKlaus'. With the help of Billie and Leo his elf-xecutive assistant, SuperKlaus will take on a toy-obsessed businessman to save Christmas.

Everyone knows that, each Christmas, Santa Claus delivers presents to every last child on Earth. What everyone doesn't know is that Santa accomplishes the feat with a very high-tech operation beneath the North Pole. But when the unthinkable happens, and Santa misses one child out of hundreds of millions, someone has to save the day. It's up to Arthur, Santa's youngest son, to deliver a present to the forgotten tyke before Christmas morning dawns.

A young boy who has grown sceptical of Santa Claus is shocked to see a train stop outside his window on Christmas Eve, destined for the North Pole. When he accepts an invitation from the conductor to climb on board, he embarks on a white-knuckle ride to Santa's headquarters, where he makes fast friends and learns an invaluable lesson about the true spirit of Christmas.

Clark Griswold sets out to give his family a traditional Christmas. While his in-laws, among them a cousin from hell, sample his hospitality, they find themselves battling against rabid squirrels, and an exploding sewer to achieve a family Christmas that they will never forget.
Chevy Chase stars as the head of the hapless Griswold family, whose Christmas plans soon descend into chaos.

Fastidious businessman Neal Page and slobbish shower-curtain salesman Del Griffith are the reluctant odd couple trying to get home from New York to Chicago to be with their families at Thanksgiving. Their thwarted travel plans keep throwing them together.
Anxious to get home for the holidays, exec Steve Martin is forced to hit the road with sales oaf John Candy. Classic comic caper. Strong language/flashing images.

Luther Krank, fed up with the commercialism of Christmas, decides to skip the holiday and go on holiday with his wife, an easy decision to make with their daughter away anyway, but when she suddenly decides to come home, uproar ensues in the rush to celebrate Christmas at the last minute.
Tim Allen and Jamie Lee Curtis cause uproar in their Christmas-crazy suburb when they give the festivities a miss. Dingdong comedy, based on a John Grisham story.
As his life unravels around him just in time for Christmas, Bernard dusts off an antique jewellery box that happens to contain trapped genie Flora, who might just be able to help him.

Finding out that he's actually human, Buddy the elf leaves the North Pole to find his real dad in bustling New York, but when he gets there, his mean old dad doesn't want to know. While he's trying to convince his father, he gets a job as a department store elf, which he should be perfectly cut out for.

When he accepts an invitation from the conductor to climb on board, he embarks on a white-knuckle ride to Santa's headquarters, where he makes fast friends and learns an invaluable lesson about the true spirit of Christmas.

pr.t: Dr. Seuss' How the Grinch Stole Christmas
pr.d: Shunned by the relentlessly happy citizens of Whoville, the Grinch retreats to his gloomy lair on Mt Crumpit. Come December, the only one smiling is the Grinch, who's stolen everyone's presents. However, a little girl sees some good in the furry grouch, so there may be a merry Christmas after all.

pr.t: Dr. Seuss' How The Grinch Stole...
pr.d: Jim Carrey is the grouchy green meany who hates Christmas and plots to steal it from the people of Whoville. Heartwarming adaptation of Dr Seuss's evergreen tale.

A gadget salesman is looking for a special gift for his son and finds one at a store in Chinatown. The shopkeeper is reluctant to sell him the 'mogwai' but sells it to him with the warning to never expose him to bright light, water, or to feed him after midnight. All of this happens and the result is a gang of gremlins that decide to tear up the town on Christmas Eve.

Dumped and depressed, English rose Iris agrees to swap homes with similarly unlucky in love Californian Amanda for a much-needed break. Iris finds herself in a palatial Hollywood mansion while Amanda navigates the lanes of a picture-perfect English village. Soon enough, both lovelorn ladies bump into local lads perfect for a romantic pick-me-up.

A troubled female cop must unravel the perfect murder as she matches wits with two homicidal schoolboys, who believe they can't be caught after committing a motiveless crime. As she gets ever closer to the truth she at once alienates her new partner and puts her own life in peril.

A divorced train commuter passes the house she used to live in with her husband every day. To distract herself she creates a fictional perfect world for her former neighbours in her head. This is ruined when one of the neighbours goes missing.

John and Jane Smith are a typical suburban couple first seen undergoing marriage counselling to try and get the spark back in their relationship. What neither of them knows is that the other is a highly skilled assassin until, separately, they get a call for their next job. Accidentally double-booked, they discover the truth about each other's secret existence, and are in danger not just from their bosses, but each other.
In a dystopian future America, a team of military-embedded journalists races against time to reach Washington, D.C., before rebel factions descend upon the White House.

Small-time crooks One Two and Mumbles decide to legitimately invest in some prime real estate and find themselves out of their depth and in debt to old-school London gangster Lenny Cole. Cole himself is in the middle of a business deal with a Russian gangster, but when his accountant tips off One Two and Mumbles to the details of an upcoming big-money business transaction, the two scallywags swoop in and steal the cash.
When his beloved wife, Kathryn, is suspected of betraying the nation, intelligence agent George Woodhouse faces the ultimate test -- loyalty to his marriage or his country.

Thriller adapted from Thomas Harris's first Hannibal Lecter novel about an FBI profiler called out of retirement to help catch a serial killer nicknamed the Tooth Fairy. The agent has the uncanny ability to project himself into the minds of his criminal prey, but the case forces him to confront his past and consult his former nemesis, the now-incarcerated Dr Hannibal Lecter.

While out hunting, Llewelyn Moss finds the grisly aftermath of a drug deal. Though he knows better, he cannot resist the cash left behind and takes it with him. The hunter becomes the hunted when a merciless killer named Chigurh picks up his trail. Also looking for Moss is Sheriff Bell, an ageing lawman who reflects on a changing world and a dark secret of his own, as he tries to find and protect Moss.

In an England of the future, Alex de Large is the leader of a gang of droogs whose pastime is violence, sex and murder, but whose eventual punishment is almost as extreme and violent as his crimes. Betrayed by the other members of his gang, he is arrested and offered an experimental treatment in order to shorten his sentence.
Ben grows suspicious of Mike and Liv's investigation, while Harry and Asta get surprise visits. (S3, ep 7 of.
When a malfunction occurs aboard a luxury space cruise ship, it's up to engineer Billie McEvoy to warn those in charge. Comedy with Hugh Laurie.
And Then He's Gonna Shoot Off...: As Rav plots a rescue mission, Ryan hears a more optimistic theory about the ship's future. Comedy with Hugh Laurie.
Jeff suspects something isn't quite right when an attractive classmate gets engaged to marry Pierce.
While working on the final diorama for their anthropology class, Chang discovers the cache of items stolen by Troy's monkey.
Just A Ride.

After a run-in with a choking hazard, Raffo is admitted to the same hospital as Bessy, leading to a collision of worlds.

Will and Grace both stumble when their political beliefs are put to the test. Jack and Karen help Will and Grace conceal their secret shame from each other, but the truth is finally revealed.
Will and Jack try to date younger guys but find it challenging. Grace and Karen experience a crisis that reveals Grace's true feelings about Karen.
On the day of Imran's chaaliswan and Sabi's birthday, Raffo struggles to find the right emotions, Bessy chooses the wrong time to apologise, and Sabi pulls the trigger on a big decision.
The tension between Aqsa and Sabi comes to a head. Paul confesses some truths to Sabi and Aqsa drops a huge bomb on Sabi and Raffo.
Stuck at the Wellfulness Commune, Lucky begins to discover some of its secrets, while Meg finally speaks with her mother.
After breaking out of the commune, Lucky and Meg rush back to Sydney, hoping to make it there in time to meet Billie at the airport.

Will and Jack are shocked to discover that two of their formerly wild friends have settled down to raise an adopted baby girl. Jack is even more shocked when Will volunteers to babysit. Meanwhile, Grace taunts Karen because she thinks she's jealous of her relationship with Ben.
Grace is horrified when her bright new intern turns into a clone of Karen, and Will and Jack are accused of sexism by two lesbians at a gay sensitivity seminar.

Judd outlines the plan for a rescue mission and tasks Iris with organising a vigil on Earth to raise the money to fund it; Rav endures a barrage of messages from the ship and handles an unruly press conference.

With Judd worried about his reputation, Iris arranges a meet-and-greet with several passengers in his luxury suite; frustrated by a bridge crew with no answers, Ryan and Billie bond with the engineers below deck.

Rob and Ellen become jealous when Will and Grace begin to pal around with a photographer and an art gallery manager.
Will's job is on the line after his boss tells him he must bring in a new client by the end of the week, or face the sack. Meanwhile, Grace and Jack try to get on TV.

When Templeton is nominated for Animal Control officer of the year, Frank sets out to rescue 24 animals in 24 hours; Victoria steps in for Shred after he's bitten by a kitten; Templeton tries to sabotage Frank's mission.
Frank's dad temporarily moves into Frank's house following a heart attack; Victoria and Patel try to find ways to replace pet food that was destroyed in a fire.
Shirley goes into labour during the anthropology exam. Shirley's husband Andre witnesses his son's birth, while Chang insists he's the father.
A paintball war pits the study group members against each other for $100,000, but when a mysterious challenger appears, they must join forces to stop him.
Grace finds it hard to call it quits with Ben, and Jack livens up his failing cabaret act at Will's expense.
Grace considers her ex-boyfriend's invitation to join him and his current girl in a romantic escapade.

Jim and Pam arrange an `Office Olympics' for the staff when Michael and Dwight got out for the day to close a deal. However, these are no ordinary sporting events, but the fruits of the minds of the bored office staff.
With Michael and Dwight out of the office, Jim and Pam lead the staff in a series of games to stave off boredom.
The staff decamp to the car park for the day when a fire starts in the kitchen. To fill the time they start to play games, which reveal a little too much about some of the team.
As a fire forces the staff to assemble in the car park, Michael tries to become a mentor to young temp Ryan.
Harry and Asta team up with an unlikely ally to try to save the Earth.

Ricky Gervais' first-ever stand-up tour 'Animals' and performance at the Bloomsbury Theatre, featuring backstage footage revealing some of the preparations and frustrations involved in a sell-out West End run.
The acclaimed, ever-hilarious Ricky Gervais puts aside his people-watching for a while to take on our animal cousins. Performed in 2003. Strong language/adult humour.

pr.t: Last Week Tonight With John Oliver
pr.d: The likeable, British-born pundit John Oliver is provided a unique platform to offer up his singular perspective and distinct voice to any number of social, political or existing issues.
Comedian John Oliver hosts an in-depth, satirical look at developments from the past seven days in news, politics and current events.

Officers deal with some clueless drivers, clothesless drivers, and roadside turkey wrangling.

Police arrest a burglar twice within a matter of days, a helicopter searches for a woman heard screaming in a park, plus officers stop a gang geared for burglary, and an argument over cigarettes flares out of control.
Customs officers come across an entire family smuggling cigarettes, and an officer cross-examines a passenger with a highly suspicious itinerary.
Giles and Roger call in for assistance when a driver races past them on the motorway, and Gareth and Finn the police dog are called to a scene where two drunk men are armed with weapons.

When Craig Hodson-Walker is killed while trying to protect his father from a gang of robbers, a manhunt begins to track down the suspects.
A look at the twisted killer who pretended to be an MI5 agent before torturing and murdering a man in his home, filming the whole ordeal and torching the flat to cover his tracks.

Police uncover chilling crimes after finding 30-year-old Kayla Brown tied up and locked in a storage container after being held hostage for 65 days by seemingly respectable estate agent Todd Kohlhepp.
In 2019, 63-year-old Marion Price's estranged husband ruthlessly shot and killed her while she had been sitting in her car, shocking the village of Earls Barton in Northamptonshire.
Reinvestigating one of the most infamous cases of recent times, that of the Austrian family captor and rapist, Josef Fritzl, who kept his daughter locked away in a cellar for two decades.
Two retirees disappear from their home near Rutland Water, and forensic scientists search for evidence to prove that the pair had been murdered.
Shock pours through a community when devoted mother Geeta Aulakh is fatally attacked with a machete on her way to pick up her children, and her husband is the prime suspect for the police.
A profile of Billy Dunlop, who murdered 22-year-old Julie Hogg in 1989 and made legal history when he became the first person convicted under revised UK double-jeopardy laws in 2006.

A look at the life and crimes of American serial killer David Richard Berkowitz, known as the 'Son of Sam', who pleaded guilty to eight separate shooting attacks that began in New York City during the summer of 1976.
Revealing how police investigators uncovered a murderer a decade after he committed the brutal 1994 killing of widowed grandmother Shirley Leach in the bathroom of a bus station in Bury.
In 2020, 20-year-old Tashan Daniel was waiting at Hillingdon Tube station for a train to take him to an Arsenal football match when a fateful encounter on the platform changed everything.
A look at the life and crimes of the murderer Victor Farrant, an ex-convict who claimed the life of Glenda Hoskins not long after being released from prison for rape and drugging.
A closer look at New Zealand cops as they deal with the challenges of monitoring the nation's busiest motorway.

Ein chinesischer Wächterlöwe aus Porzellan ist vor Jahren zerbrochen und soll nun restauriert werden. Für das exotische Familienerbstück von Caroline Morris bittet Jay die Keramikkonservatorin Kirsten Ramsay dringend zur HIlfe.

Als eine Kundin versucht, die wertvollen Comics ihres Sohnes zu verkaufen, holt Wayne einen Experten an Bord, um sie schätzen zu lassen. Ein Oldtimer-Feuerwehrauto weckt währenddessen Randys Interesse an einem neuen Deal.

Ein russischer Magnat bietet den Brüdern das Geschäft ihres Lebens an. Doch mitten in den wegweisenden Verhandlungen verschwindet Wayne spurlos, was den gewagten Deal und die gemeinsame Zukunft plötzlich massiv ins Wanken bringt.

Bodo hat es mal wieder vermasselt: Lisbeth bekommt nichts zum Geburtstag, Bodo aber schon. Der Dackel hat an Lisbeths Geburtstag Namenstag. Sie beschließt zu einem alten Verehrer zu ziehen, der ihr in einer Geburtstagskarte seine Liebe gesteht.

Immer häufiger hört Dieter in den Medien von sogenannten Schläfern, die plötzlich gewalttätig werden. Er befürchtet, dass diese auch in seiner Siedlung sind. Er dringt deshalb in die WG mit den jungen Leuten ein. Dabei isst er dort ein paar Pilze.

Axels Vater hat den Vater-Sohn-Tag vergessen und nimmt einen Geschäftstermin wahr. Axel ist enttäuscht. Er beschließt, seinen Vater aus dem Termin herauszuschleusen. Leider geht seine Rechnung nicht ganz auf.

Wegen eines Missverständnisses denkt Axel, er habe nur noch einen Tag zu leben. Schlagartig fällt ihm ein, dass sein Testament noch nicht geschrieben ist und dass er noch viele Dinge tun wollte. Er beginnt, seine Liste abzuarbeiten.

Ein Mann versagt bei jeder Aufgabe, die ihm zugeteilt wird: Er ist weder in der Lage, dass Schwert aus dem Stein zu ziehen, noch ist er fähig, den Heiligen Gral zu finden. Und als die Tochter endlich ein Brüderchen bekommt, ignoriert sie es.
Bastian, Hugo-Egon Balder, Oliver Kalkofe und Maddin Schneider sollen gemeinsam eine Panel-Quiz-Show aufzeichnen. Doch keiner versteht die Regeln und der Produzent der Show ist ein Blender.
Anne bittet Bastian seine alten Videokassetten auszusortieren, doch er bringt es nicht fertig die 32 Edgar-Wallace-Filme wegzuschmeißen. Dann gibt es auch noch Ärger mit den Nachbarn.
Bastians Vater ist dabei eine Grabstelle für ihn zu finden und dann auch gleich einen Sarg auszusuchen. Das soll der Familie die Arbeit ersparen. Doch die Meinungen gehen weit auseinander.

Bei der HYLO PDC Europe Super League kämpfen Deutschlands Darts-Profis um den begehrten Startplatz für die PDC Darts-Weltmeisterschaft. Spannende Duelle, hohe Scores und spektakuläre Checkouts sorgen dabei für Darts-Action auf höchstem Niveau.

Die Krause-Eltern sind entsetzt: Tommy hat einer Mitschülerin an die Brüste gefasst. Kurz darauf stellt sich heraus, dass Tommy vielleicht gar kein Krause-Nachwuchs ist. Dieter recherchiert im Krankenhaus und setzt Tommy daraufhin vor die Tür.

Alle freuen sich auf den geplanten Mallorca-Urlaub. Doch es gibt ein böses Erwachen: Dieter hat das ganze Urlaubsgeld ausgegeben. Bodo wurde zum Drogenspürdackel ausgebildet. So soll verhindert werden, dass in der Siedlung Drogen verkauft werden.

Sheldon's arch nemesis invites the guys to a party at his house and Leonard decides to go, angering Sheldon. Howard gets the opportunity of a lifetime, but his decision doesn't sit well with Bernadette.

Sheldon's mum Mary comes to visit and soon becomes a firm favourite with all the gang. Sheldon is annoyed with his friends for liking his mum but refuses to believe that he's jealous of the time they're spending with her.
Leonard questions his feelings for Priya when he kisses a girl he meets in the comic book store. The rest of the gang pull pranks on Sheldon in celebration of Halloween.

When Axl accidentally breaks down the front door, Mike insists that he fix it in order to teach him a lesson, which leaves the Heck house wide open for days. At work, Frankie needs to sell a car within a week, or she will have to wear a dog suit outside the lot for promotion.

Frankie accidentally hits Brick in the head with a beer bottle when trying to get the rubbish out before the bin lorry leaves, but when Brick innocently tells his school that the scratch was caused by his mother throwing a beer bottle at him, a social worker comes to evaluate the Heck family. Meanwhile, Bob helps Mr Ehlert shoot a commercial for the car lot.
Frankie's plan to have an idyllic family Thanksgiving backfires when Mr Ehlert demands his staff work over the holiday. Meanwhile, Brick goes missing in a corn maze.
Sheldon discovers that Mary's been keeping a secret about his future. Meemaw is furious when she learns Dale fired Georgie.
After graduating from high school, Sheldon has a breakdown when he realises he may not be ready for college; Dale tries to make amends with Meemaw.
Sheldon gets a summer job at the local train museum; Missy embarks on a new stage of womanhood; Georgie discovers Mary's guilty pleasure.
Amy is heartbroken when she finds out that Penny and Bernadette went shopping for bridesmaids dresses without her.
Leonard and Penny attempt to hang out without anybody else around, while Sheldon faces his fear of birds.
Sheldon is jealous when Stuart from the comic bookshop invites Amy out on a date, so he asks her to be his girlfriend.
Leonard confronts the man who bullied him in high school, while Penny realises she did her fair share of tormenting in the past.
When Sheldon proves dismissive of Amy's career accomplishments, Penny, Raj and Leonard try to make him realise that sometimes it's beneficial in a relationship to pretend to care about things.
Leonard decides to ask Penny out on a date, and they both agree to give their relationship another chance.
Leonard and Penny decide to put their relationship through a test, allowing them to report the problems they have with each other.
After Sheldon keeps Leonard awake all night, Leonard decides that he needs a break from Sheldon's thankless demands and the roommate agreement is formally broken, ending the friendship between them.

Wayne and Garth decide to stage a rock festival. After losing his late-night cable show, Wayne has a dream in which Jim Morrison tells him to put on a massive music festival - Waynestock. Before this can be achieved, the budding promoters must overcome several hurdles and sort out their turbulent love lives.

Alan Titchmarsh and the team present the makeover show, transforming unloved spaces into dream gardens for some very special people. In this episode, Alan and the team create a space-age garden in rural Cornwall for Chris Finney and his family. In 2003, Chris became the youngest serviceman ever to receive the George Cross, awarded for his extraordinary courage under fire, but since leaving the forces he has not always found civilian life easy.

The Smith family embark upon a mammoth declutter. Stacey and the team challenge them to let go of half of their possessions, so that they can beautifully reorganise their life and home. An aerial adventure through the landlocked country of Zambia that takes in sights including the largest migration of mammals on Earth, the huge Victoria Falls, and the meandering Zambezi River.
Explores the great diversity in natural landscapes and life in the country of Mozambique through visits to the country's Indian Ocean coastline, mountain rainforests, and Zembezi River delta.
Journeys through the diverse landscapes, rich cultures and linguistic customs, and remarkable flora and fauna of Cameroon, a country that sits at the crossroads of West and Central Africa.

Explores the great variation in the landscapes of Botswana. Includes visits to the salt pans of the Makgadikgadi, the maze of marshlands and floodplains within the Okavango Delta and the Kalahari Desert.

Beginning in the Silver State of Nevada, Michael takes to the skies over the dramatic Sierra Nevada mountain range. At Lake Tahoe, he hears of the first European explorer, known as 'The Pathfinder', whose discovery opened up the west for settlement. Travelling on the historic Virginia and Truckee heritage line, Michael investigates the vast deposits of silver and gold ore on which Virginia City was built.

Armed with his trusty Appleton's Guide, Michael Portillo reaches San Francisco, where he boards one of the city's iconic cable cars. Behind the scenes in the engineering powerhouse, he uncovers the street cars' secret to scaling the city's famously steep hills. In the Presidio neighbourhood, a leading publisher introduces Michael to San Francisco's long tradition of fine printing and book-making. Michael takes the opportunity to have his own treasured book appraised.

Following his Appleton's guide, Michael Portillo makes a trip to the jewel in the crown of America's National Parks, Yosemite, to behold its towering granite cliffs, its giant sequoia trees and cascading waterfalls. He discovers how early conservationists fought to protect it in law and encounters a 'buffalo soldier' in the heart of the forest. In Berkeley, Michael uncovers a catastrophic event, which hit the city of San Francisco hard in 1906.

Steered by his late 19th-century Appleton's guidebook, Michael Portillo continues through southern California aboard the Coast Starlight rail service. In the historic port of Monterey, Michael raises the Bear Flag of the one-time Republic of California and above it, the Stars and Stripes. He discovers the city's Spanish and Mexican heritage and traces how the former fishing port described as 'stinking and decrepit' in John Steinbeck's novel, 'Cannery Row', has become a beacon for tourists.

Michael Portillo strikes oil in the suburbs of Los Angeles, contemplates his navel in the orange groves of Riverside, makes a California roll and paints a pretty picture in Laguna Beach. It is Mexican Independence Day and the locals are celebrating the country's hard-won independence from Spain in the early 19th century.

Michael Portillo's nineteenth-century Appleton's guidebook leads him to the Parker House Hotel, where in his best pinny, he whisks up a Boston cream pie. In the fine dome atop Massachusetts General Hospital, where no-one could hear the screaming, Michael discovers the scene of grisly surgery, first made bearable, in 1846, by a miraculous new substance. North of Boston, in Salem, Michael is caught up in a witch hunt.

Guided by his Appleton's and tracing the footsteps of the Pilgrim Fathers, Michael Portillo heads for Plymouth, the 'home town' of America. He learns how indigenous tribes of Wampanoag people taught newly arrived settlers to live off the land, inspiring one of the biggest holidays in today's American calendar.

Armed with his Appleton's guide, Michael Portillo continues his rail journey through Connecticut and New England. He takes a crash course in rowing in New Haven, where college teams from Yale and Harvard have battled for victory on the water since 1852. In Vermont, Michael visits a 19th-century farm, where the rich milk from prized Jersey cows imported from the British Isles supplied a thriving butter industry.

Michael discovers how Richard Wellesley amassed a private army which numbered a quarter of a million.
India: Michael travels to India to uncover how the British East India Company - the world's first multinational corporation - raised a private army to create an empire.
In Jamaica, Michael reveals how pirates, slaves and sugar gave Britain its wealth.
Jamaica: Michael visits Jamaica, the Caribbean capital of the Empire, heading to Fort Charles where the Empire enlisted the help of pirates to defend the new territory from the Spanish.

Michael Portillo picks up his rail journey from Warwick to Rye along the River Thames. In Reading, he traces the origins of education for workers. Messing about in boats is the name of the game in Henley on Thames, where Michael slips into a launch to hear about the world-famous regatta. Afternoon tea on the bank offers a chance to hear about four heroes of early 20th-century literary classic `The Wind in the Willows'.

In Belfast's grand Edwardian City Hall, Michael investigates the scene of a watershed moment in Irish history and hears how thousands of Ulster Protestants were mobilised by train to sign a document pledging opposition to Home Rule for Ireland.

Clutching his 1930s Bradshaw's Guide, Michael Portillo reaches Bodmin en route to Totnes as he explores the West Country from St Ives to Salisbury Plain. Out on the rugged moor, Michael hears how the celebrated author, Daphne du Maurier, captivated readers between the wars with her tales of smuggling at the Jamaica Inn.

Armed with his interwar copy of Bradshaw's Guide to the Railways, Michael reaches the Kent seaside resort of Herne Bay, where he learns about a pioneering aviatrix who began her working life as a typist in Hull but whose epic achievements made her an international celebrity. Michael takes the train five miles west along the coast before heading offshore into the entrance to the Thames Estuary.

Michael Portillo arrives in Manassas, scene of two crucial battles during the American Civil War. This surprising grand tour follows the river Ythan in rural Aberdeenshire, which flows through a landscape of wheat fields and haunted castles and on to a coast rich in wildlife. On the way, Paul Murton learns how to make a haystack, speak the local 'Doric' and has a ghostly encounter with a woman in Fyvie Castle. He visits Gight Castle, the ruined home of the poet Lord Byron's family. Journey's end is at the mouth of the river where sand dunes have created Scotland's version of the Sahara.

Natalie Ray is a 30-year-old mum of four, married to 🥊 [MMA] MMA fighter Stevie 'Braveheart' Ray. Right now he's just one fight away from becoming Scotland's first world champion. This is the all-or-nothing tale of his $1M prize fight, and the aftermath, told through Natalie's eyes. Mixed martial arts is a full-contact sport that many will know as cage fighting. Kirkcaldy-born Stevie has risen from fighting on the street to competing on MMA's world stage.

Mit einem satirischen Blick werden Nachrichten aus Politik, Kultur und der Medienwelt unterhaltsam präsentiert. Berühmte Gäste und Moderatoren arbeiten aktuelle Ereignisse humoristisch auf und kommentieren die politische Weltlage.

Mr. Hankey ist der Regisseur der Weihnachtsshow. Doch mit seinem anstößigen Verhalten droht er diese Aufgabe zu verlieren. Währenddessen müssen sich Strong Woman und PC Principal mit Herausforderungen in ihrer Beziehung beschäftigen.

Am Kolumbus-Tag verhält sich Randy ziemlich daneben und sorgt für reichlich Verwirrung. Er zerstört unter anderem eine Statue des berühmten Entdeckers und missbraucht das Wort "einheimisch". Die Kinder fragen sich, was da wohl los ist.
Tina, Gene und Louise machen mit ihrem illegalen Snackverkauf an der Schule großen Reibach.
Tina wird mit etwas konfrontiert, das noch beängstigender ist als ihr Erzfeind Trupp 257.

Roger hat sein Archäologiestudium abgeschlossen, doch seine Familie nimmt ihn trotzdem nicht ernst. Er versucht alles, um Francine von seinen Leistungen zu überzeugen. Unterdessen hat Steve Probleme, einen Aufsatz über Stans Arbeit zu schreiben.

Die Familie führt ein Theaterstück auf, in dem Stan seinen Geburtstag nicht feiern möchte, weil sein Vater ihn an seinem achten Geburtstag verlassen hat. Erst hatte er ihm die Schuld dafür gegeben, doch dann findet er mehr über die Trennung heraus.

Chris ist auf der verzweifelten Suche nach dem perfekten Geschenk zum Vatertag. Doch Vater Julius wünscht sich nichts sehnlicher als einfach einen ganzen Tag für sich allein. Rochelle macht mit den Kindern lieber gleich einen Ausflug.
Chris muss sich mit dem Gedanken anfreunden, dass Keisha nach Kalifornien zieht. Nachdem Julius' Truck gestohlen wurde, organisiert Rochelle eine Nachbarschafts-Wache.
Mike bittet Ryan, Boyd alleine nach Hause gehen zu lassen. Kyle und Ed halten ein Meeting ab.
Vanessa ist der Meinung, dass Eve es mehr unterstützen sollte, eine Präsidentin zu haben.
Weil Lois für ein paar Tage verreist ist, kann Malcolm mehr oder weniger frei tun, was er will. Und als Erstes bastelt er mit den Nachbarskindern an einem Killer-Roboter.
Malcolms Mutter hält Augen und Ohren offen, und so bleibt keiner der Streiche, die Malcolm und seine Brüder aushecken, unentdeckt.
Petes Ex-Frau Carol taucht während Sams und Jays Halloween-Party in Woodstone Mansion auf.

Mit einem satirischen Blick werden Nachrichten aus Politik, Kultur und der Medienwelt unterhaltsam präsentiert. Berühmte Gäste und Moderatoren arbeiten aktuelle Ereignisse humoristisch auf und kommentieren die politische Weltlage.

Stan und Francine haben keine Lust, auf Steves Elternabend zu gehen. Deshalb übertragen sie Roger die Vormundschaft. Er nimmt seine Rolle etwas zu ernst und sorgt bei den Besprechungen dafür, dass Steves Schulleiter gefeuert wird.

Stan trifft seine alte Liebe aus dem CIA-Ausbildungslager und hat wieder Gefühle für sie. Francine kocht vor Eifersucht. Unterdessen hat Steve aus Versehen Hayleys Unterwäsche in der Schule getragen und hat seitdem eine absolute Glückssträhne.

Auf der Mission, Honig von einem weit entfernten Planeten zu holen, nimmt die Crew versehentlich eine Bienenkönigin mit an Bord. Die sticht in ihrer Panik Leela, die daraufhin in ein zweiwöchiges Koma fällt, in dem sie schreckliche Alpträume hat.

Der Professor hat es geschafft, ein Paralleluniversum zu erschaffen, doch es gefällt ihm nicht. Bei dem Versuch, es loszuwerden, taucht die Crew des Paralleluniversums im Planet Express auf. Die Originale finden das zunächst gar nicht gut.
Die Belchers verbringen eine wilde Nacht im Casino und Linda erfährt mehr über ihren Großvater, als sie je wollte.
Tinas erotisch angehauchter, pferdelastiger historischer Roman ist weg und landet bei einem Fremden.

Butters kommt auf die Idee, E-Zigaretten zusammen mit dem Zubehör an der Schule zu verkaufen. Außerdem muss Randy derweil mit seiner Familie aufs Land ziehen. Dort probiert er erstmals die Tätigkeiten eines Farmers nachzugehen.
Die Kinder machen es sich zur Aufgabe, so viele Halloween-Süßigkeiten wie niemals zuvor zu sammeln.

Die Familie macht Urlaub, und Francine hat Stan ein Arbeitsverbot erteilt. Dieser kann sich natürlich nicht daran halten, sodass es am Ende sogar sein Chef mit Francine zu tun bekommt. Hayley und Jeff wollen ihre Beziehung auffrischen.

Francine findet, dass sie und Stan sich voneinander entfernen, weil er zu viel Zeit mit seinen Kumpels verbringt. Steve und seine Freunde werden unterdessen in einer Boyband aufgenommen und nehmen gleich ein Musikvideo mit ihnen auf.

Claire erhält ein Jobangebot von einer Hotelkette und hadert mit der Entscheidung, Jays Firma zu verlassen. Gloria nutzt Mannys Zustand nach einer Weisheitszahn-OP aus. Phil, Luke und Haley zwingen Alex dazu, den "Senior Ditch Day" zu feiern.

Alex hat ihren Highschool-Abschluss in der Tasche und will mit ihrer Familie feiern. Phil kann leider nicht dabei sein, da er sich auf einer Dienstreise eine Ohrenentzündung zugezogen hat und nicht fliegen darf. Andy schaltet ihn via Skype hinzu.

Malcolm ist überglücklich, denn Vater hat endlich Karten für den Wasserrutschen-Park besorgt. Doch dummerweise erinnert Reese Mutter daran, dass Malcolm Schnupfen hat und besser eine Nasenklammer tragen sollte.

Als Malcolm, Reese, Lois und Hal vom Wasserpark nach Hause fahren, wird die Straße wegen eines Verkehrsunfalls gesperrt. Nun muss die Familie bei über dreißig Grad mit mehreren anderen hundert Autos im Stau ausharren.
Trevors Bruder meldet sich, nachdem er eine Lücke im Woodstone Rewards Points-Programm entdeckt hat.
Als sich Louise für einen Wettbewerb anmeldet, wird Bob von seiner Vergangenheit eingeholt.

Für die Teilnahme an den Olympischen Spielen 3004 unterzieht sich Bender einer Geschlechtsumwandlung. Er kann sogar fünf Goldmedaillen gewinnen, bekommt aber Probleme, als sein Lieblingsstar Calculon sich in ihn verliebt.

Um dem neuesten Upgrade von Mom zu entgehen, flüchtet Bender kurzerhand auf eine einsame Insel. Dort trifft er auf drei weitere Leidensgenossen. Auf der Insel vergessen die Roboter den Stress des Alltags und kommen auf allerlei dumme Gedanken.

Stan Smith muss, wie James Bond, einen Bösewicht jagen, der einen teuflischen Plan ausheckt. Der Black Villain möchte den Nordpol schmelzen, um eine große Flutwelle zu erzeugen. Stan muss alles daran setzen, seinen Plan zu durchkreuzen.

Als Francine beobachtet, wie Hiko ihre Tochter Akiko fördert, um sie auf ein Elite-College zu schicken, möchte sie das gleiche für Steve erreichen. Doch dieser ist nur im Buchstabieren begabt und es kommt zum Wettstreit zwischen Steve und Akiko.

Steve will immer noch unbedingt die Brust eines Mädchens anfassen, was ihn dazu veranlasst, dem Wasserballteam der Schule beizutreten. Doch auch da hat er wenig Erfolg. Schließlich bittet er Klaus um Hilfe und wird zum Star des Teams.

Tween Wave ist die neue angesagte Musikrichtung der Kids. Jedoch verbieten die Eltern ihren Kindern, diese Musik zu hören, da sie sich "Kacke" anhört. Als Stan zu seinem 10. Geburtstag auch verboten wird, Tween Wave zu hören, hält er sich nicht dran. Als er jedoch Tween Wave hört, klingt es auf einmal auch für ihn wie "Kacke". Besorgt, geht er zum Arzt. Dieser diagnostiziert, Stan hätte "das zynische Arschloch Syndrom".

Phoebe finds a police officer's badge and goes on a spree of arrests until she meets up with the owner, while Joey wonders if he is in love with Monica.

Rachel has an interview for her dream job at Ralph Lauren. All goes well until she inadvertently kisses the interviewer, and at the second interview she mistakenly berates him for his `sexual intentions'. Meanwhile, Monica competes to have a better relationship than Phoebe's, and Joey is arrested for stalking a sexy neighbour with whom Ross gets a date.

Rachel's new boss and colleague both smoke. When Rachel discovers that they make business decisions without her in the smoking room, she pretends to be a serious smoker so she can be part of the discussion. Meanwhile, Ross's son and Joey audition for the same commercial, but only one of them can get the part.
Ross really likes the pretty pizza-delivery woman, but his flirting technique is awful. Meanwhile, a nasty surprise awaits Joey when he tells everyone about his big television appearance.
The gang are enjoying a ride in Phoebe's boyfriend's cop car until a gunshot rings out. Also, Rachel overhears a telephone message for Ross.

After Gary confides in Monica that he intends to ask Phoebe to move in with him, Monica immediately breaks her promise to him and tells Phoebe, who worries that it is too early in the relationship. She persuades Chandler to talk to Gary, hoping that Chandler's fear of commitment will rub off on him, but Gary's enthusiasm overwhelms even Chandler.
Joey's first major film role leads to an unexpected experience in Las Vegas. Meanwhile, Phoebe can't quite remember why she hates Ross.
The gang travel to Las Vegas, Nevada, where more than one surprise awaits them. After Ross misinterprets Rachel's actions, a war of public humiliation results.
The gang are having fun in Las Vegas, where Monica and Chandler get lucky, Rachel makes Ross regret playing a prank on her, and Joey schemes for fame and fortune.

Everyone is toasting Chandler and Monica's engagement, but after Chandler fails to come up with the goods in the bedroom, he begins to worry about the consequences. Elsewhere, Monica thinks Rachel is trying to steal her glory when she catches her kissing Ross.

Monica's dream of a fairytale wedding fizzles out after she learns what her parents have done with her wedding fund. Meanwhile, Rachel fumes when a teasing Joey stumbles across her juicy late-night reading material.

Chandler's desperate effort to bond with Monica's dad by playing racquetball backfires when he accidentally gets too up-close-and-personal. Elsewhere, Rachel tries to teach 'landlubber' Joey how to sail without falling overboard, while Monica seeks to replicate Phoebe's late grandmother's secret recipe by deconstructing her last remaining cookie.

Rachel must hire an assistant and agonises over whether to hire an efficient, experienced woman, or sexy young Tag Jones. Ignoring her friends' advice, she hires Tag and soon regrets it. To make matters worse, Tag is attracted to Phoebe.

While taking an engagement picture for himself and Monica, Chandler can't stop pulling a strange face, Rachel enlists Joey to take Tag out for a night on the town, and Phoebe and Ross date a couple in the middle of a divorce.

Wedding fever continues when Monica can't decide whether to appoint Rachel or Phoebe as her maid of honour. To help Monica decide, Joey and Ross test them on how they would react in certain wedding situations.
